# model.createTimer

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Create a timer.

```lua
model.createTimer()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

the new timer

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local timer = model.createTimer()
timer:name("My Timer")
timer:direction(-1)
timer:value(60)
```
